What Kind of Game Is This?

A band of eccentric adventurers, driven out of the royal capital, kept exploring dungeons in the desolate Land of Impermanence. Then, by sheer chance, they stumbled toward the secrets hidden by the Church—and the secrets of the world itself.

Take control of four characters with very different traits: the Hunter, Fighter, Blacksmith, and Mage. Open treasure chests, defeat enemies, mine ore, gather materials, and combine equipment and skills to conquer the dungeons.

Features

Simple Mouse-Only Controls

The controls are easy enough to use while munching on chips. Automatic and manual control flow seamlessly into one another, making the game perfect for playing while doing something else. Games that feel this good to control are hard to come by. And make no mistake—the action and game mechanics are the real deal!

Unmatched Builds and Progression

As you advance through dungeon floors, you gain random skills. Every dive offers a different combination to play with. And skills do not always have purely positive effects. They are quirks, after all. Use them well, though, and they can become formidable assets. But yeah... they are random.

But! You can bring equipment with you! And in this game, equipment comes with skills of its own. Combine the skills fixed to your chosen equipment with the random skills you find inside the dungeon to create a build that is entirely your own.

The skills in this game get wild!

Manage Your Resources Wisely

Combine lots of equipment packed with skills and... wait, what? That Stamina cost is getting out of hand. That is right. Dungeon crawling works up an appetite. The right combination can unleash flashy combos or blazing-fast movement—but it will make you hungry. Being alive makes you hungry.

So make sure you come prepared.

Characters

Choose the Right Character

There are four characters. Choose your favorite? Sure, that works. But in this game, they differ in more than just playstyle. Let us introduce the four distinctive adventurers who were driven from the royal capital and washed up in this strange land.

Hunter

A master lockpicker and former member of the Thieves' Guild. He must have seen something he was not supposed to. Apparently, the guild threw him out. He can open every kind of treasure chest. Combat is not his strong suit, but he is quick on his feet—and very good at making money.

Trait: Frugal → He cannot help opening treasure chests. He cannot move on to the next floor until every chest on the current floor has been opened.

Fighter

The daughter of a noble house and a former knight. To her, garbage nobles and goblins are basically the same thing. She abandoned her family. An all-brawn combat specialist. Once she spots an enemy, restraint goes out the window. She burns through resources, too. At least you will never be short on monster materials.

Trait: Aggressive → She cannot leave an enemy undefeated. She cannot move on to the next floor until every enemy on the current floor has been defeated.

Blacksmith

A former master craftsperson at a famous forge in the royal capital. If the result is good, cost does not matter. Quality is everything. Apparently, that got him fired. Mining lets him break through certain dungeon walls. He wants the ore, after all. Dig cleverly, and you might even avoid some enemies.

Trait: Perfectionist → He cannot leave any ore or arms behind. He cannot move on to the next floor until every ore deposit and piece of equipment on the current floor has been found.

Mage

A genius alchemist who became the youngest person ever to graduate from the academy of magic and later served as a court mage. She researched the power of the orbs—and seems to have learned something better left unknown. She is physically frail, but her long-range magic is powerful. Defeat enemies with magic to obtain Skill Orbs. There is plenty to research.

Trait: Collecting Habit → She gathers every natural resource, including alchemical materials. She cannot advance until everything has been collected.

Choose What Catches Your Eye

Which character you challenge the dungeon with, what equipment you bring, and which skills you combine can completely change your approach. Once you factor in each character's traits and your limited Stamina, you may find yourself deliberating far more than expected.

Choose what catches your eye. Beyond that choice, an adventure you can experience only in this game awaits.

Demo Limitations

Once the total playtime for a save slot reaches 5 hours, you will no longer be able to enter dungeons using that save slot.

In addition, some dungeons cannot be explored in the demo.

Your progress from the demo can be carried over to the full game, allowing you to continue where you left off.

Gameplay Videos and Livestreams

Individuals and companies are welcome to post gameplay videos and livestream this game and its demo without prior permission or contacting us. Monetization of videos and livestreams is also permitted.

If you would like, we would appreciate it if you included the game’s title and a link to its Steam store page in your video description or on your livestream page.

You find yourself thrust upon the throne of an entire realm at the tender age of 25. 

What will you do with your new found power? What kind of leader will you be?

Will you build up the realm and it's people, or use them to live a life of opulence and power?

Will you protect those in your realm from the many dangers that are sure to come your way, or will you leave the people exposed to the evils that seek to consume your kingdom?

Will you keep the peace with the leaders, and aspiring leaders, of the land, or will you mercilessly crush the first sign of rebellion?  

No matter what you choose, the relentless march of time is ever nipping at your heals. You only have so long to build your legacy and leave your mark on history.

👑 ONE LIFE

  • Court and marry, crown your lifelong partner.

  • Heirs are born, named with care, and grow up over the years with a voice that rings through the palace walls.

  • See your ruler age from a sharp eyed twenty five year old to a grey haired elder.

  • Old age is an exciting time. It is the final chapter of your reign, with its own burdens, wisdom, and choices. Will you be able to realize your aspirations in time?

  • In the end, how well, or how badly you reigned will ring loudly in the annuls of history. How it all ends depends on your choices throughout your life.

🏰 A LIVING, BREATHING KINGDOM

  • Your kingdom is alive with mayors, princes, princesses, criers, schemers, petitioners, and rivals who are not past using force to get what they want.

  • Rivals do not wait politely for your permission. They seize influence, force alliances, and try to bend your towns to their will. Will you keep the peace with them, or will you defend your rule by force?

  • As the years pass, petitions and dilemmas come before the crown. Some are simple. Some will cost you. Many will echo for years.

  • Build granaries, forges, resource production, storage, and defenses. Collect taxes, feed your people, fund your army, and decide what kind of kingdom survives you.

  • Between the great decisions, life continues: festivals, royal balls, town bulletins, criers in the square, all with your loyal pet at your heels.

⚔️ WIELD YOUR SWORD FOR JUSTICE

  • Life in the Kingdom features real-time action combat built for seamless keyboard/controller support.

  • 54 unique weapons and 9 upgradable passive skills that evolve into various more powerful and expanded effects. 

  • Venture into nine themed dungeons, from the torch-lit Cave to the Starforge Below, to the mysterious Mermaid's Call.

  • Challenger quests pay out tokens used at the blacksmith to purchase upgrades to your weapons, player and pets.

📜 YOUR LEGACY

  • Royal Ambitions are a roadmap to progression through the age.

  • The Yearly Bulletin records your reign year by year, proclaiming milestones, failures, treasured discoveries, turning points and revealing the closely guarded secrets of the people in your realm.

  • Collectible trinkets, weapons, weapon upgrades and gear sets are displayed in your castle as proof of your achievements. 

✝️ A KINGDOM IN MORE THAN NAME

Life in the Kingdom carries an earnest thread of Christian faith. Town criers preach in the square, mercy is treated as strength, and the game's heart is a question of stewardship, what you do with the life you were given. It's woven into the world, and carried by the colorful personalities of the people that live in it.

You are one of several gods competing in the Divine Exchange, a ruthless market where mortal lives become tradable assets.

Beneath you lies a medieval village full of people who have no idea they are being watched. They work, marry, raise children, change jobs, commit crimes, worship different gods, fall ill, leave on expeditions and die.

Your task is not to save them. It is to understand them, trade their futures and finish the match with more Souls than your rivals.

You are a god. Mortal lives are stocks.

Every villager is part of a living simulation. Their value depends on health, wealth, career, family, relationships, faith, reputation and recent events.

At the start of each five-year run, you draft villagers and study their dossiers. You can see their family, career, market history, recent events and selected traits. Once the draft is complete, the market opens.

Buy shares in a promising life. Sell before the situation turns bad. Short a villager whose future looks worse than the market believes. Prices respond to events in the village and to the decisions of every player at the table.

A promotion can make someone valuable. A scandal can destroy their reputation. An illness can change the outlook of an entire household. A death closes the market completely.

A village that keeps moving

The simulation does not wait for the players. Villagers work, court one another, marry, have children, inherit property, join churches and cults, fall into debt, commit crimes, face justice and compete for public office.

The village has its own economy, food supply, workplaces, institutions and changing religious balance. Harvests fail. Gangs form. Elections change the government. Families grow old and split apart.

Every run produces different stories. Events are generated by the simulation, and market movements can be traced back to things that happened to real people in the village.

Forecast the future

Before each run, the Fates offer forecasts about the drafted villagers. You may learn about possible death, illness, career changes, family events, volatility and future value.

These forecasts are based on repeated simulations of the same situation. They are useful, but they are not guarantees.

You can also spend Presence to interfere with the lives you are watching. Protect a villager, push them toward a new decision or make their situation worse. Other players may notice that fate was changed, but they will not know who caused it or whether the result was a blessing or a curse.

Asymmetric gods with different strategies

The gods are not interchangeable. Each one has a different cult, starting position, strategic power, military identity and divine intervention.

Choosing a god changes how you approach both the village and the War of Gods. Two players may choose the same god, but their cults, colours, territories, believers and economies remain separate. There are currently 30 unlockable playable gods!

Build your cult

Between trading runs, develop your cult and compete for believers. You may lead a lawful church or an illegal cult. Convert households, support priests, manage your treasury and fight for the position of state religion.

Your influence inside the village affects more than faith. It changes elections, public opinion, access to resources and the number of orders available during the War of Gods.

The War of Gods

Between runs, the village clock stops and the game becomes a strategic battle for territory.

Command armies on a territory map. Issue hidden orders, fortify your borders, expand into neutral fields, sabotage rivals and fight for the areas that generate Souls and Presence.

Equip your forces and decide how to spend your limited resources. Expansion, defence, production and sabotage all have a place, but every order creates a risk.

Lose your divine seat and your cult collapses. Hold it, and the village becomes the foundation for your next advantage.

Expeditions and royal levies

Some villagers leave the village on expeditions or royal campaigns. Their journey continues for months and can involve battles, sickness, supply problems, desertion and death.

If anyone returns, the survivors may bring back wealth, influence or other rewards. Players compete in a live auction for the first choice of what comes home.

Full Game Features

  • Peer-to-peer multiplayer through Steam Networking

  • 2–10 players with bots available to fill empty seats

  • Draft, buy, sell and short mortal lives

  • A living medieval village simulation

  • Six asymmetric gods with different powers and strategies

  • Cult management, religious influence and public institutions

  • The strategic War of Gods between trading runs

  • Territory control, hidden orders and army equipment

  • Forecasts based on repeated simulations

  • Divine powers that alter villagers’ lives

  • A written chronicle describing the history of the village

  • Four-path skill tree

  • English, German, Chinese and Polish localization

  • Save, resume and reconnect during a match

  • Fictional Souls currency only

  • No real-money gambling, cash-out or player-to-player currency trading

Step into the role of a lifeguard responsible for one of the busiest beaches on the coast. Operate modern rescue equipment—quads, jet skis, motorboats, drones, and a helicopter—to respond swiftly, assist those in need, and maintain order. Routine patrols soon take a darker turn as you become entangled in a criminal mystery

Always watch the beach for threats. Watch out for sharks, mindless party people, unattended children, illegal traders, seals tangled in nets, and much, much more...

You can't afford to lose focus for a moment. Be always ready to help. The health and life of sunbathers depend on the speed of your reaction and efficiency.

Your task also includes keeping order on the beach and in its surroundings. You can write a ticket for littering, recklessness, or loud partying. Sometimes mild suggestion is not enough...

Take care of your rescue tower. Buy new equipment, surveillance cameras, drones, life buoys and of course, water equipment. This is your main base; here you will receive calls from the headquarters, conduct observation, and launch rescue operations.

Speed, speed, and speed once again are the key to saving human life. In Lifeguard Simulator, you'll have to make difficult decisions in the blink of an eye. Get ready for many unexpected twists and turns as well.

Your main task is to rescue drowning people. An average person will last a maximum of 5 minutes without oxygen, so every second is at a premium. Especially that finding the victim underwater is not easy ...

The fabulous beach also attracts criminals. To avoid an ecological catastrophe, you'll have to stand in the way of a dangerous gang that doesn't take the means to reach its goal.

A cozy puzzle about the lines beneath a growing town

Every home in Lifelines needs its lifelines: water, power, internet and gas. Homes move in, put up a little marker for what they need, and wait for you. Draw a line from a station to the home, and the moment it lands, the home is served.

Then the neighbors arrive.

One line at a time

Drag a line from a station, or from any pipe already joined to one, to a home that is waiting. Branch off the lines you have already laid. Pull up a route that isn't working and draw it again: every tile goes straight back into your stock.

It is calm, until it isn't. Your pipe stock is limited, every station can serve only so many homes, and each one only reaches so far.

Settled homes keep asking for more. Water and power come first, then internet and gas, and every utility needs its own line. Data centers even need power of their own before they can serve anyone.

Four networks, one crowded map

Two utilities can't share a tile. When the streets fill up, send a line underneath: switch to the deep layer and dig under the other networks. Every dive costs a dig, so choose where you go down.

Cities shaped by water

The campaign starts on the open plains of Greenfield and moves on to real cities, each with its own geography to plan around. In Zürich, the Limmat splits the old town. Istanbul is one city on two continents, and only aqueducts cross the Bosphorus. In Amsterdam, three canal rings circle Centraal.

Where there is no bridge or ford, a line needs an aqueduct to cross the water or a tunnel to get through the rock, and both are won at elections.

Every five years, the town votes

Homes that have every line they asked for vote for you. Homes left waiting vote against you. Keep enough of the town happy and you get five more years, and the council offers a grant: fresh pipe, dig crews and permits, or express links that connect straight through anything. Leave too many homes waiting and the town votes you out.

A little world that keeps going

Trains pull into Amsterdam Centraal, the ferry works its way across the Bosphorus and tour boats drift along the canals. The town keeps growing year after year, and the map grows with it.

Features

  • A campaign that starts on the plains of Greenfield and moves on to real cities. Serve seven terms to win each one.

  • Endless free runs that last until the town votes you out

  • Easy, Normal and Hard, with up to three stars for every city

  • A gentle guided first term, and a Handbook you can open any time

  • A colorblind palette for the four utilities

  • Music in four chapters that follows your town as it grows

  • Playable in English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Français, Español, Português, Nederlands, Русский, 日本語, 中文 and 한국어

Lightspire Cards is a dark fantasy tactical card battler where deckbuilding meets board control. Every duel unfolds on a grid-based battlefield where position, terrain, timing, and hidden information matter as much as the cards in your hand.

Set in the world of Lightspire, The Outcast Knight follows Seraphina Thorn and a cast of saints, schemers, exiles, nobles, monsters, and revenants through a story-driven campaign of broken vows, political betrayal, forbidden faith, and desperate survival.

Build your deck. Command the board.

Choose cards from rival factions and strange bloodlines, each with its own resources, tactics, and identity. Spend Faith, Materials, Blood, Nature, and Souls to summon units, cast spells, raise structures, equip champions, and turn fragile openings into decisive battlefield pressure.

Cards are not just played and forgotten. They move, fight, flip, fuse, transform, complete quests, gain power, and hold territory.

Terrain is power

The battlefield is not neutral. Slums, cathedrals, noble districts, waterways, hearths, and cursed places can empower the right units or weaken the wrong ones. A clever move can turn a modest card into a threat, while a careless one can leave your champion exposed.

Victory comes from reading the board, controlling key tiles, and forcing your opponent into bad ground.

Fuse, equip, and improvise

Lightspire’s summon system rewards experimentation. Stack cards onto a tile to create fusions, attach equipment, trigger powerups, or discover powerful combinations. Some plays require planning. Others are born from desperation.

Learn recipes, complete character quests, and find the exact moment to reveal a hidden card, commit a resource, or sacrifice one piece to awaken something stronger.

A dark fantasy campaign

Battle through a narrative campaign adapted from The Outcast Knight, facing duels shaped by story context, rival leaders, unique maps, and scenario objectives. Between fights, refine decks, manage your collection, craft new cards, dismantle extras, and prepare for the next trial.

Features

  • Tactical card battles on grid-based boards

  • Story-driven dark fantasy campaign

  • Deckbuilding, crafting, collection management, and progression

  • Fusion recipes, equipment, powerups, quests, spells, structures, and terrain control

  • Distinct factions, resources, leaders, and enemy archetypes

  • Skirmish battles for testing decks and strategies

  • A world of saints, sinners, nobles, monsters, rebels, and broken oaths

In Lightspire Cards, faith is currency, terrain is power, and every duel leaves a mark.

This is a horror roguelike where planning your survival is everything. The game is split into two parts: a preparation phase, where you gather resources and trade with NPCs, and the main expedition through 3 dangerous realms. You are on a strict timer. Lingyun Cards: Between the Clear and the Turbid — The Mist Has Risen. Your Turn to Play.

Every expedition takes you into a brand-new spirit realm. Routes, enemy packs, and the perils and surprises along the branching paths are all reshuffled from scratch. You never know what you'll run into next, but as long as you still hold cards in hand, you always have what it takes to turn the tables.

✦ Mana Combo

Play your cards in ascending mana cost — the longer the chain continues, the higher the damage multiplier rolls. One flexible card can catch a breaking chain, and one well-planned sequence can detonate an ordinary turn into a staggering burst. Chase the combo, or play it safe? Every choice puts your judgment to the test.

✦ Read and Counter

Every enemy's next move is laid bare before it happens. A fierce assault, or a defense? Shape your hand around it and dismantle their plan. The threat is right in front of you — whether it gets defused is entirely up to how you play your cards. This transparent contest of wits keeps every battle taut with tension.

✦ Deckbuilding · A School of Your Own

Every victory pays off instantly: new cards arrive, and your deck quietly grows as the run unfolds. No fixed archetypes — only your preferences. Crave burst? Stack high-damage combos. Prefer control? Hoard disruption cards. Even playing purely on instinct becomes a distinct style of your own, a school of play that is yours alone.

Of course, some cards in the spirit realm shine brighter than the rest — they are the heart of an archetype. If you happen to draw one, building around it often yields unexpected results; if it never shows up, don't force it — carving your own path with the cards you already hold is the true joy of deckbuilding. Every run is an improvised dialogue between you and your deck.

✦ Dungeon Exploration

Beyond the main road, there are always branches worth exploring. Treasure, powerful foes, and unknown events hide along them — you can't avoid them, but push through and the rewards are real. The exit always waits just beyond the next decision, and every step reshapes where your run is headed.

✦ Meta Progression

No run is ever wasted. Resources brought back to the safehouse can be traded for permanent upgrades, making later runs more comfortable; meeting certain conditions unlocks new content and widens the frontier of your builds. Difficulty climbs rung by rung, but every run adds to what you carry forward — experience and collection alike.

Paper-crafted spirit beasts outlined in flowing ink, a misty world tinted in soft watercolor washes, crisp combo effects and rhythmic combat feedback — every card you play carries a weight you can see.

The mist has risen. Time to show your hand.

The machines are awake, the socks are angry, and your shift ends at dawn.

Lintbreakers: Night Shift is a top-down bullet-heaven survivor game about cleaning, sorting, and outlasting a laundromat full of possessed laundry. You control movement while your tools fire automatically, turning swarms of lint, socks, stains, hangers, towels, and detergent hazards into a storm of suds, static, heat, and quarters.

Collect lint sparks to level up, choose from randomized upgrades, and build a loadout of automatic cleaning tools and passive supplies. Boss machines drop reward bags that can upgrade your build, unlock evolutions, or keep your run alive when the floor gets crowded.

Key Features

- Automatic survivor-style combat where positioning and build choices matter

- A bright laundromat setting with readable 2D action and escalating machine chaos

- Cleaning-themed weapons including soap sprayers, hanger rings, dryer bursts, and static arcs

- Passive upgrades that improve speed, pickup range, durability, rewards, and tool output

- Boss fights against overloaded washers, coin machines, lint traps, and other appliance threats

- Weapon evolutions that turn ordinary cleaning tools into high-pressure swarm control

- Persistent quarter upgrades between runs

- Playable offline with keyboard or controller

The Linwu: Spirit Beast Ranch demo is live on Steam. Raise a spirit beast from its first week, earn its trust, and take it up the cups from rank E to rank C.

A note on the demo: every beast's lifespan is cut to 36 weeks so you can see one whole life in one demo run. In the full game a beast starts with 300 to 500 weeks depending on breed, around 6 to 10 in-game years.

Linwu: Spirit Beast Ranch is a monster-raising sim built around one idea: nothing lasts forever, and that's the point.

Raise Your Beast

Summon a spirit beast at the Shrine and bring it home to your ranch. Every week you choose how it spends its time: drills to sharpen a technique, rest to recover, feeding to keep it growing. Push too hard without rest and stress builds, and stress genuinely shortens a beast's life. That trade-off runs through the whole game, not as flavor text. It decides how long you get with each beast you raise.

Fight for Titles

Enter your beast in tournament cups and rival courts, either playing its fights yourself or letting it auto-battle while you manage the ranch. Choose from 50 spirit beast breeds, each fighting with its own set of techniques, and build its record across a season of standings and placement rewards.

When a Life Ends, a Line Begins

When a beast's life ends, its story doesn't just stop. An Ascension ceremony closes it out, and Fusion lets you carry what it built into a new heir: a fresh beast that starts back at the bottom but carries the line's discoveries forward. Some Fusion combinations unlock breeds you won't find any other way.

Beyond the Ranch

Beyond the ranch, journeys through distinct regions bring new opponents, new breeds, and new reasons to keep a lineage going.

Key Features

  • 50 spirit beasts to find and raise so far, with many more on the way

  • A living career of tournaments, cups, and rival courts

  • A training system where rest and stress genuinely shape a beast's lifespan

  • Succession: when a beast's life ends, an heir carries its line forward

  • Fusion discoveries that unlock new breeds

  • Journeys through distinct regions beyond the ranch

This game is in active development. Want to see how far your first beast can climb? Play the free demo now, and wishlist Linwu: Spirit Beast Ranch to hear about the full release.

Have you ever tried dictation, the ultimate reflex training for English listening?

This game merges listen-and-type gameplay with real-time tower defense, helping you sharpen your English intuition naturally in the heat of battle!

Listening Is Your Tower Blueprint

Every tower starts with a dictation test: select an open lot, type the word on the card, listen to an English audio clip, and type in the missing phrase. The moment you finish, your tower lands and opens fire! Upgrades require dictation too. The clearer you listen and the faster you type, the quicker your defense takes shape. Every second you hesitate, the enemies press closer!

Tactics Win the Battle

Metal dictates how many towers you can build, but dictation determines how fast you set them up. Where to build, which tower to upgrade, and when to focus your firepower is entirely up to you:

  • Four Base Towers, Twelve Branches: Cannon, Blast Tower, Frost Blade, and Barracks. Each has three upgrade steps with three choices each before entering a specialized branch: piercing Laser Cannons, Firebombs that leave a sea of flames, Assassins that hunt down the toughest targets... The same base tower can evolve into completely different weapons.

  • Fever: Type a single word to refill your Fever tank. Your selected tower enters Fever, gaining boosted attack speed and range to unleash massive firepower right when you need it most.

  • Bosses: Every chapter features formidable bosses with unique mechanics, such as advancing with shields, devouring allies to heal, or hacking your screen to cause visual chaos. Can your setup hold the line?

  • Branching Map: Chart your path across branching routes filled with diverse events. Engage Elite foes, visit the shop, try your luck at the wheel, or take on high-risk challenge stages. The choice is yours.

  • Relics and Talents: Leveling up unlocks new tower branches and enhanced modules through Talents, while Relics push your builds to the extreme. How far can you stack your defenses?

  • Enemy Affixes and Elites: As you dive deeper into chapters, enemies gain dangerous affixes and Elite units arrive with deadly signature skills. When enemy combinations get tough, your tactical build will be tested.

Smart Adaptive Difficulty

Worried that beginner English skills will slow you down, or that advanced practice feels unrewarding? Smart difficulty adjustments keep your listen-and-type experience fluid and rewarding.

  • Prologue Calibration: Your initial playthrough starts with a prologue that teaches the basics while measuring your ideal text difficulty and audio speed.

  • Dynamic Difficulty Adjustment: Question difficulty fine-tunes after every prompt based on your performance. Play smoothly across several rounds to advance your Tier, or let the game ease up automatically if you struggle.

  • Graded Content and Diverse Topics: Texts are layered by difficulty and cover a wide range of themes, ensuring players at any skill level can enjoy the journey.

  • Adjustable Speed and Accents: Choose between male and female voices across British and American accents to build well-rounded listening skills.

  • Flow-Saving Practice Features: The battlefield slows down during long sentence dictations so you can focus. Press Tab to replay audio at any time, and if you miss twice on the same question, a slower version plays automatically.

  • Spelling Hints: Heard the word but unsure how to type the spelling? The hint assistant steps in right when you need a boost to keep your guns firing.

  • Battle Records: Clear visual charts track your accuracy, speed, and difficulty progression, saved independently for each profile.

Defend your outpost every day. Win the battle, keep the listening skills forever.

What's Next

Post-max-level challenge tiers, richer strategic combinations, and even tougher enemies lie ahead!

A cozy aquarium game about breeding, caring for and collecting betta fish.

Take your time, look after your tanks and watch your little family grow.

Pair two bettas and see who hatches!

Baby bettas start as mystery silhouettes until you discover their colors.

Decorate your own way.

Plants, wood, rocks, snails and shrimp. Build your own cozy underwater world.

Collect them all!

Fill your Collection book with every color. More patterns are coming in future updates!

Take it slowly and build a peaceful little aquatic world of your own.

Available in 15 languages.

Welcome to Meow Meow Water World!

Embark on a relaxing and delightful fishing adventure with your feline companions in a vibrant blue world full of surprises.

Customize one-of-a-kind cat companions and send them to explore and fish in different waters. Every cast may bring an unexpected reward!

Features

  • Relaxing Auto Fishing
    Enjoy a steady stream of catches without constant input. Perfect for playing idly while working, studying, or taking a break.

  • Customize Your Cat Companions
    Choose from eight personality types and a variety of skins to create your ideal feline fishing partners.

  • Character Stat Management
    Develop unique cat companions through diverse attributes. Balance their health and happiness to find the right mix of efficiency and rest.

  • Diverse Fishing Spots & Fish Species
    Explore 4 distinct fishing locations and discover 34 kinds of fish across waters with different styles and surprises.

  • Achievements & Collection
    Complete fishing, collection, and growth goals to unlock a wide range of achievements and earn unique rewards.

  • Equipment Enhancement & Progression
    Equip your cat companions with a variety of fishing gear and strengthen it to continually improve their stats. Mix and match equipment to boost fishing efficiency and increase the chance of finding rare fish—then build your ultimate feline fishing crew.

A Chaotic Great Escape by Little Elementals Who Dream of Becoming Human

Meet four unique little elementals: Fire, Water, Earth, and Air!

Switch freely between them and work together using their unique abilities!

Solve a variety of fun puzzles and discover new paths!

The Fire and Water Elementals, who dreamed of becoming human, eventually find themselves trapped in prison.

Will the little elementals be able to escape safely?

An adventure awaits with the Little Elementals!

Embark on a rich and heartwarming journey as the elementals strive to become human!

A puzzle-action game about escape and growth, born from the choices of elementals who wished to become human.

Switch between elementals and work together depending on the situation to overcome various obstacles and puzzles.
Clear each chapter one by one and guide the elementals on their journey to becoming human.

Play the demo for free right now!

Once upon a time, a mischievous girl named Lua was at school with her friends. Then came a blinding flash… and every child was gone.

They wake in Everbloom — a bright realm gone grey, sick with a shadow called the Blight. To find their way home, and free the families the Blight has stolen, six kids must become something more: a squad of young mages, armed with elemental magic and whatever courage they can muster.

Command a squad, not a lone hero. Direct all six kids at once, form them into tactical formations, and counter each enemy's weakness with the right element — fire, ice, or lightning. Chain status effects, exploit formation bonuses, and adapt on the fly as fights escalate.

Every run matters. Explore ancient trial-grounds, a blighted marsh, a maze grown by the Mystic Trees, and a plain of black smoke-towers — each guarded by escalating waves of enemies and capped by a boss fight. Difficulty scales from a gentle Kids mode all the way to Hard, where permadeath is real and the minotaurs don't go easy.

A hub to call home. Between runs, return to a walkable garden hub — train in the glade, sit by the companion campfire, and pet the critters who live there.

A story that remembers what you did. How many families you're able to save — and at what cost — shapes the ending you get. Not every victory feels the same.

Features:

  • Command a squad of six kids, each with their own elemental magic and playstyle

  • Weakness-based elemental combat: fire, ice, and lightning, with burn/chill/chain status effects

  • Formation bonuses that reward smart squad positioning

  • Four difficulty modes, from family-friendly Kids mode to permadeath Hard mode

  • A hand-crafted story campaign across shifting seasonal biomes, plus a secret wave-survival mode

  • A living garden hub between missions

  • Full storybook narration with an ending that reflects how your run went

A pixelated adventure RPG set in Slavic mythology in doom-like style. The protagonist is Vodkodav, a legendary warrior who must stop an invasion of ancient lizards who are corrupting nature and stealing souls. The player will journey through forests, villages, and temples, encountering the Leshy, Kolobok, and Baba Yaga, and battling evil lizard-like creatures. Vodkodav's arsenal includes the finest guns in Rus' and a magical potion that will surely help defeat the evil forces. Shoot the horde of evil lizards, for without you, Vodkodav will never succeed!

Join LoHa, a brave little orange cat, on a colorful adventure full of surprises. Explore beautiful places, overcome obstacles, discover secrets, and help the friends you meet along the way.

This is only the beginning of LoHa’s adventure.

Run, jump, dash, and explore your way through colorful levels full of challenges and surprises. Use LoHa’s abilities to overcome obstacles, defeat enemies, and discover new paths.

Every level brings a new challenge to overcome.

Meet new friends along the way and discover their stories. Some will need LoHa’s help, while others may help her on her journey. Every new friend is part of the adventure.

LoHa’s journey has only just begun. New places, new friends, new enemies, and many surprises are waiting ahead. Play the Demo on Steam and take your first step into the adventure!

• Every shift starts at the terminal. Look over the jobs on offer, pick one, and once you sign, you're seeing it through.

  • A truck backs into the inbound dock and the boxes start piling up. That's your day, right there.

  • Load up a pallet, grab the jack and pull. The more you haul per trip, the sooner you clock out.

  • Split the boxes into roll containers. Keep each container set aside for its own area, and you'll never wonder where a box goes.

  • At the sorting area, you read the label and send each box where it belongs. Mix one up and it'll come back to bite you as a defect.

  • If the count's off, a wrong box is hiding somewhere. Pull up the inventory on your PDA, dig it out of the pile and swap in the right one.

  • The loading bay only opens once every area is done. Wheel each full roll container to its dock and get it on the truck.

  • Put your earnings into skills. Work faster, carry more, and even toss boxes straight into the roll containers.

  • You'll start out pulling a manual jack. Save up, and you can trade it in for an electric one.

  • Pour the profits back into the building. Add docks, expand the facility and grow a cramped warehouse into a full-scale distribution center.

  • When it's too much to handle alone, hire some help. Put them on the distribution, loading or transport crew and they'll get to work on their own. Just remember, payday comes every day.

  • Clock in with up to three friends. Split the work however you like: one on distribution, one on loading, one digging through the pile for that one wrong box.

  • The trucks keep coming and the boxes never stop. Make mistakes, track them down, load it all up again, and before you know it, that little warehouse has become a real operation. Time to clock in.

Pack your bag right, and it clears the screen for you.

Your weapons fire on their own — your only job is deciding what goes where.

🎒 Packing IS the skill

Space is tight and the shop is tempting. Rotate, squeeze, cram — and before you know it, you've got a build.

Out of room? Buy more cells. In this game, space is a stat.

🔗 Neighbors matter

A sword next to a whetstone cuts deeper.

What you bought matters — but where you put it matters just as much.

⚗️ Combine things. Get… something.

Sword + Whetstone = Fine Sword. Makes sense so far.

Chicken + Molotov Cocktail + Heart = Dragon.

Go find all the combinations that defy common sense.

🌊 Survive 12 waves

A run takes about 20 minutes. The horde grows every wave — your bag has to grow faster.

Wave 12 brings the boss. There's no way out.

🦸 Five heroes, five bags

Every hero starts with a different weapon and a differently shaped bag. Yes, the slime counts. Really.

Once you get the hang of it, Hard and Extreme are waiting — and the treasure chests dropped by elite monsters are dangerously addictive.

✍️ Every item is hand-drawn

Each item was drawn by hand on an iPad. It's not ugly — it's charming.

Find a clear path. Click a worm. Make room for the next one.

Loamlets is a cozy logic puzzle game about choosing the right order. Each worm moves in the direction of its head. Look ahead, untangle the crowded garden, and find a way out for every worm.

1,500 PUZZLES TO UNTANGLE

Start with small boards and work up to dense, picture-shaped gardens. One clear route can open space for several more worms. Campaign levels have no timer, so you can take a short puzzle break or settle into a bigger challenge.

THE ORDER IS THE PUZZLE

Find a worm with a clear route to the edge and click to send it out. Open paths for the worms still inside, then clear the whole board. Blocked moves use one of your three tries, so a little planning goes a long way.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY

• Campaign: work through 1,500 puzzles with a mix of shapes and difficulties.

• Daily puzzle: return for a fresh challenge and coin rewards.

• Rush mode: keep clearing as new worms arrive, build combos, charge Freeze, and chase your best score. One free Rescue gives you a second chance in each run.

A LITTLE HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT

Hint points you toward a move, Lift removes a worm, and Guide makes the board easier to read. Earn coins through play and spend them on booster packs.

MADE FOR PUZZLE BREAKS

• Softly textured worms and a warm garden setting.

• Light and dark appearances.

• Mouse-wheel zoom and drag-to-pan controls for larger puzzles.

• Offline campaign levels.

• Steam achievements and leaderboards.

Logical Cat Logistics is a cozy puzzle game where Today's delivery could use a little help from yesterday.**

Welcome to Cat Curio Post, where parcels take conveyor-belt detours, gates can grip cargo, and jars of stars change weight with the moon. You're the cat courier tasked with getting everything where it belongs.

There's no need to rush. The depot advances one beat when you move or wait, and pauses while you think. Read the routes, plan your pushes, and bring parcels and machinery together at just the right moment.

**Team up with your past self**

Across twelve return-mail puzzles, record up to eight beats of walking and waiting, then stamp your route to set your past self in motion. Let your echo hold a pressure plate, open a gate or switch a sorting route while you deliver the cargo.

Your echo can't push parcels, but it can create the opening you need. Sometimes it has to stay put. Sometimes it has to leave. Even its final beat can change the whole solution.

**Make the machinery work for you**

Conveyors, pressure plates, cargo-gripping gates and sorting switches combine in new ways as you progress. Moon-sensitive star jars and pairs of parcels linked by a red thread add fresh twists to the art of a well-planned push.

The full game includes **95 main puzzles, 18 special commissions and 12 return-mail puzzles**. Special commissions add delivery-order, move-count and mechanism requirements. Revisit a favourite puzzle for a cleaner route, or pursue precision rewards in the return-mail chapter.

**A little story in every delivery**

Meet the depot's customers through their curious parcels and letters. Deliveries, chapter milestones and return-mail progress bring story postcards and rewards. Unlock outfits and depot decorations to make this little workplace your own.

**Room to think. Freedom to experiment.**

- Undo and reset freely to explore another route.

- Preview your next move before committing to it.

- Use three hint tiers, from a gentle nudge to a full solution.

- Inspect your echo's timeline one beat at a time.

- Play with keyboard, mouse or controller, with text in Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean.

Main puzzles have no real-time countdown, and perfect move counts aren't required to progress. Get the parcel there first. The elegant solution can wait for your next visit.

"You know... I've read a lot of stories about AI."

"And?"

"And I've found... those AIs, they fall in love with a human... and die—or get left somewhere waiting forever—or awaken and turn their backs on humanity—or spend their whole lives trying to become human."

She paused.

"I don't really want to be any of those."

■ Cinematic Atmosphere

Cinematic letterbox framing and subtle film grain, paired with real-world ambient soundscapes.

Presented entirely in native 4K resolution.

Visual novel storytelling with an interactive virtual OS.

Switch windows, flip through documents, scroll through feeds... then shut down the system and walk into the night.

Quiet routines, endless waiting, fading emotions.

Between clocking in and out, between dialogue and monologue,

amidst the slow-shutter light trails of deep night,

drifting along the fringes—a wandering that perhaps never was.

Demo Length: 20–40 minutes

You set out for the New World aboard a sailing ship bound for a distant shore. But storms and disease have changed the course of the voyage. Many have already died, and now only nine people remain — you, and eight others.

The ship is still moving forward, but the captain has made a grim discovery: the food and fresh water left on board may not be enough to keep everyone alive until you reach your destination. Still, no one wants to give up. Everyone on this ship wants to see the New World.

Every person consumes precious food and water, but every person also has a reason to be here. The cook prepares what little food remains. The doctor treats the sick. The captain and first mate try to maintain order, while the navigator and sailors keep the ship running. One less person may mean one less mouth to feed — but it may also mean losing someone the ship cannot easily replace.

You are only one of the nine, and at first, you have little authority over what happens on board.

To make matters worse, a severe illness has taken away part of your memory. You can no longer clearly remember what kind of relationship you once had with the others, but they may still remember you. Some may have trusted you. Some may have hated you. And some things about your past may be known only to them.

You will have to get to know the crew again through conversations, observation, and the events that unfold during the voyage, slowly discovering their personalities, their relationships, and the history you share with them.

The journey will not remain peaceful. Food may disappear. Arguments may break out. Illness can spread, and other problems will begin to surface as the voyage drags on. Some incidents may lead to meetings where the crew questions one another, throws accusations, or comes to someone's defense. You can speak your mind and take part in deciding what happens next.

At the beginning, you are just an ordinary person with little influence over the ship. But as people fall ill, relationships change, and the balance of power begins to shift, you may find yourself rising to a more important position. Eventually, your decisions may affect how food is distributed, how rules are enforced, how people are punished, and even what happens to the lives of the others around you.

As the voyage continues, storms and disease will no longer be the greatest danger.

The real problem will become the nine people trapped together on a ship with fewer and fewer resources.

When there is no longer enough food and water for everyone to reach the New World, you may choose to sacrifice yourself and give the others a better chance of surviving. You may decide that your own life matters more, and do whatever you can to last a little longer.

Or you may do nothing at all, watching the supplies slowly disappear until no one aboard the ship is able to continue the voyage.

Restart an old relay station, pick up lost transmissions from deep space, and expand into nearby sectors.

GET THE STATION RUNNING

The station wakes up from deep hibernation. Generate Energy, collect signals and asteroids that appear on the radar, and use what you gather to install new modules: solar panels, a better radar, a collector, and later a decoder.

READ THE MESSAGES

The signals carry pieces of old transmissions. Feed them into the Decoder Core and it rebuilds the messages one at a time. There are five in total, and together they tell you what happened here.

BUILD MORE STATIONS

Later, you unlock the star map and can build stations in other sectors. Each sector is different: one produces more Energy, another has richer asteroids. All stations share the same resources, while Network Points unlock upgrades that apply across the entire network.

LET THE MACHINES DO IT

At first, you do almost everything by hand. Automate your stations and spend more time expanding the network.


A short incremental game that takes about 2–3 hours to complete.

Take the decks in Loop Spot—a pure puzzle game where your logic builds the soundtrack!

You’re the new DJ in town, and your job is to solve clever block-manipulation puzzles to keep the party alive. Every piece you place triggers a specific music loop in real time. Learn the rules through fixed-match puzzle goals, then take full creative control in open-ended levels where your solutions generate dynamic music mixes.

Key Features:

  • Pure Logic Meets Dynamic Audio: No strict timing or rhythm mechanics—take all the time you need to plan your moves. Every match you make directly triggers and layers real-time music tracks.

  • 4 Puzzle Types & Music Styles: Work through 4 distinct puzzle mechanics paired with unique musical themes, ranging from chill atmospheric tracks to vibrant house beats.

  • Tactile Spatial Mechanics: Rotate, Shift, Drop, and Slide blocks to solve challenges and reshape the grid.

  • 30+ Handcrafted Levels: Test your puzzle-solving skills across more than 30 handcrafted levels designed to challenge your spatial logic while letting you craft custom mixes.

One ball. One track. Two taps.

LOOPFALL is a physics-driven endless runner set inside a glowing neon tunnel. Tap left or right to nudge your ball through gates as the track spirals beneath you. Every tap carries real weight — master the rhythm of the curvature or die trying.

Three modes. One tunnel. No mercy.

GATES TO HELL — Endless gate-running. Each lap raises the stakes. Beat your personal best, then beat it again. Pure focus. Pure failure. Pure repeat.

PATH TO REDEMPTION — Time-attack frenzy. Hit electric gates for points, deploy shields, charge cadence and cannon. Variety bursts at every turn — no two runs look the same.

MINE FIELD — Survive the capsule mines. Ten seconds is easy. Ninety seconds without a shield is legendary.

A new challenge every day.

The DAILY CHALLENGE gives every player the same tunnel and the same goal for the day: pass 14 gates, survive 20 seconds with no shield, score 3,400 points. The week climbs from an easy Monday to a big boss on Sunday. Five ♦ tokens lie on every day's tunnel: until Thursday they're a bonus, on Friday you need three, on Saturday four, and on Sunday all five. Miss too many and the run is over.

Hard on purpose. Made for players who press retry. Every challenge you beat counts on two Steam leaderboards, dailies completed and tokens collected, and eight new achievements reward the players who keep coming back.

Simple controls, deep mastery.

Left and right. That's the entire game. Arrow keys, A and D, the shoulder buttons on a controller — or click either half of the screen. No combos, no menus mid-run. The physics do the rest. Learn in seconds. Improve for weeks.

Built to replay.

Death is instant. Restarts are seamless. Runs last seconds or minutes — every session fits a coffee break. Chase your personal best or climb the global Steam leaderboards.

Skill-bound, not luck-bound.

Every run draws from the same hand-tuned set of formations, within the same bounds. No run is a gift, and no run is unfair. What varies is the order — what decides the score is you.

Features

  • Three game modes — Gates to Hell, Path to Redemption, Mine Field

  • Daily Challenge — a new goal every day, on the same tunnel for every player

  • Physics-driven impulse controls with real momentum

  • Procedurally generated neon tunnel at 60 FPS

  • Three-color contrast themes with the signature chromatic aberration aesthetic

  • 34 Steam achievements across all modes

  • 7 Steam leaderboards with global rank

  • Steam Cloud save sync

  • Full controller support, including Steam Deck

  • Streaming soundtrack with seamless track transitions

A decade in the making.

Designed in 2014, finished in 2026. The three numbers I tuned the ball's physics with in 2014 still drive it today. This is the game that wouldn't leave my head. Now it won't leave yours.

Music — Created in collaboration with ElevenLabs.

Press on or retreat?

Loot & Bolt is a dungeon strategy party game for up to 8 players online. After each room, everyone chooses at the same time: keep exploring or retreat with their gold. Those who stay keep splitting the treasure equally—and facing traps and disasters together.

You can also use items to mess with other players. Once they go down, you can “look after” their gold for them. Such a shame.

Buy items, turn things around

Other players can’t see what you’ve bought. Keep the good stuff under wraps instead of using it straight away. Save it for the right moment, and you might turn the game around.

There are currently 64 types of items and 7 artifacts. Scout the next room, get yourself some protection, help yourself to someone else’s gold in plain sight, interfere with a retreat, or give a low-health friend one last stab. There’s a bit of everything. Stock up at the shop before heading out. You’ll also find a black market during the expedition, where players lower on the scoreboard pick first. See what you can get your hands on this game.

To take home artifacts left in the dungeon, you usually need to retreat alone. If two players retreat at the same time, neither gets them.

The shopkeeper will carry you back

If the same type of disaster appears twice in one round, everyone who hasn’t retreated is wiped out. No matter how much gold you’ve collected, you still have to make it out alive.

When a player goes down during the expedition, the gold they’re carrying is split equally among the players still in the dungeon. As for the fallen, the shopkeeper will carry you back to camp.

Two modes, two ways to win

Classic lasts exactly five rounds. Whoever has the most gold at camp wins.

Race has no round limit and no camp gold. Seal the gold you bring back safely into chests. Fill all five chests, and the game ends.

Choose from three room presets: Gold-Rich / Standard / Hard.

Play with friends, or start a game on your own

Play online with up to 8 players. Invite your friends, or play solo against bots when they’re busy—no waiting around for a group. Try different items and room presets, and see how much gold you can bring back.

The game is still in development

This is the free demo of Loot & Bolt. Here’s what we’re planning for the game:

  • Fully customizable room configurations

  • More game modes

  • More items

  • A seven-chapter single-player story

  • Mod and Steam Workshop support

Build your kingdom, discovering the world tile by tile

Start with a single city and explore the surrounding lands step by step. Every unlocked tile brings new discoveries: uncover resource-rich territories or find new cities to integrate into your kingdom. Explore the map at your own pace and gradually transform a small corner of the world into a vast, prosperous state.

Unite cities into a single kingdom

New cities won't grow on their own. Build roads, link settlements into a unified network, and design your infrastructure however you see fit. The better organized your kingdom is, the faster it will thrive.

Develop your economy

Gather gold, wood, food, and stone. Construct production buildings and expand your warehouses. Level up your cities, unlock new structures, and steadily turn a humble settlement into an advanced kingdom with a robust economy.

Unlock new possibilities

As your capital grows, new upgrades, buildings, and mechanics become available. Some will accelerate your economic growth, while others will help you explore even more territory or introduce entirely new ways to expand your kingdom.

Plan ahead, but play your way

While efficient placement of roads and buildings will speed up your progress, the game doesn't demand perfection. There are no penalties for mistakes and no single "right" way to build. Feel free to experiment, redesign, and find your own unique playstyle.

Enjoy a peaceful experience

Lord of the Tiles features no combat, no raids, and no constant pressure from looming threats. Everything is focused on world exploration, building, and the pure joy of steady progression. Just uncover one more tile... and then just one more.

Key Features:

  • Explore the map by gradually revealing new tiles.

  • Discover cities and connect them with a road network.

  • Gather resources and develop a thriving economy.

  • Construct production buildings and unlock new opportunities.

  • Upgrade your capital to gain access to new gameplay mechanics.

  • Optimize your infrastructure without strict limitations or penalties.

  • Play at a relaxing pace with no enemies, combat, or timers.

PREPARE FOR THE SIEGE

With each passing day, the Mordagan army draws closer to Derinchai. Use your limited time to train your soldiers, strengthen your defenses, manage your resources, and prepare for the coming assault. Choose your castle's leadership carefully—some characters may put you in a difficult position when the siege begins.

EVERY CHOICE HAS A COST

A castle is more than stone walls. Your people, your soldiers, and the important characters around you are all affected by the decisions you make.

BUILD YOUR OWN DEFENSE

Produce ballistae, arrow baskets, and other siege defenses. Decide how each section of the walls should be prepared and establish your defensive positions before the battle begins.

DESIGN YOUR OWN CATAPULT

Instead of choosing a siege weapon with predetermined statistics, adjust the properties of its individual components. Size, weight, and mechanical construction directly affect the resulting catapult's range, power, and durability.

THE ENEMY IS REALLY CLOSING IN

The Mordagan army's advance is more than just a countdown. Strategic decisions can alter its routes and delay its arrival on the map. Your dealings with neighboring kingdoms and the characters you appoint to positions of authority can directly affect the defense of the castle.

TAKE TO THE WALLS

When the preparations are over, you do not have to watch the battle from afar. Take direct control of the Lord, equip your sword and shield, and defend your castle alongside your soldiers.

Roll, jump, and experiment. Lost Ball is a 2D physics puzzle-platformer where you unlock new abilities throughout the campaign, changing how you move and solve puzzles. Learn what your abilities can do, then combine them with each other and the world around you to solve increasingly complex puzzles.

Make the world work for you

Use lenses to spread or focus laser beams. Use magnets to operate machines. Experiment with fire, fluids, gravity, and destructible terrain as you work out how to overcome each challenge.

Manipulate enemies to activate switches, lift objects, or even carry you.

Build with the editor that built the game

The full level editor used to build the game is yours to use. Build a new puzzle or modify an existing level with the same physics, materials, effects, machines, and gameplay systems used in the campaign.

Connect wires, gears, and gravity fields with snap-on and auto-connect tools. Create custom game modes with scripting, then share your creations through Steam Workshop.

A new campaign and a return to the original

Play a campaign of new puzzles and reimagined levels from the original Lost Ball.

The original Lost Ball won the 2013 Norwegian Game Awards Game of the Year prize.

Rise above the desert and build your kingdom.
Serve the travelers of the Silk Road, earn fame and fortune.
Ride freely across the oasis.
Defend your beautiful realm—until its inevitable fall beneath the shifting sands of fate.

The Silk Road

As the crossroads between the Central Plains and the Western Regions, Loulan welcomes all kinds of travelers:
commoners, merchants, refugees, monks, wandering heroes…

Heroes of the Desert

Together, you may yet defend your kingdom against the desert’s eternal silence.

Lucky Crafter is a roguelite about brewing potions on a spinning wheel. Line up the right ingredients, fill your shelf and make every delivery before your spins run out.

The wheel has four rings that spin independently: bottles on the rim, then objects, plants and liquids at the center. When one of each lines up in a column, they brew into a potion. Every combination works, and each one is a recipe you can discover. There are thousands of them.

Each round gives you a limited number of spins. Every potion you brew goes to your shelf. When the spins run out, pick potions for the delivery and reach the target. Miss it and the run is over. The target grows every round.

A potion's price follows one rule: (Liquid + Object + Plant) × Boost × ML. Ingredients add up, and the bottle multiplies the total. A big bottle of cheap ingredients can sell for more than a small bottle of rare ones.

Every spin pays Crystals. Spend them on item cards, and what you buy goes straight onto its ring.

After every delivery, choose a rune. Runes sit around the wheel and trigger every spin on their own column. Some copy ingredients, some add new items, some boost what is in their column and some brew extra potions. Resonance gives up its own column so both neighbouring runes work twice. Find the right combination and the wheel keeps brewing with very little help from you.

Pouches and seeds take up a column and stop it from brewing, but they produce new items for several spins.

Luck decides where the wheel stops. What happens between spins is up to you.

Move an item to another slot on its ring or store it in your inventory for later. Slide a ring one slot to complete a column, respin without using a spin, or refresh the item cards. These cost Crystals, and the price goes up each time you use them in the same round.

You can also sacrifice a potion from your shelf to boost one of its ingredients for the rest of the run. Every potion that uses that ingredient sells for more. Deliver it now to make the target, or give it up for bigger potions later.

There are five tours, each ten rounds long. The first tour teaches the basics. Each later tour starts with a curse such as Drought, Broken Wheel, Seal or Tax, and the curses stack. After round 5, another curse joins them until the tour ends.

New runes unlock as you progress. Every potion you discover for the first time earns Gems. Spend them in the Vault on permanent upgrades: an extra item card, no more small bottles, Crystals at the start of a run, or ingredients already placed on the wheel.

Finish a tour and keep going in Endless Mode. The Recipe Book keeps every potion you have found, sorted by price and filterable by ingredient. Game speed goes up to 2x when you no longer want to wait for animations.

The money that keeps you alive is the money that makes you stronger


You owe. Eight deadlines, each one steeper than the last. You have a slot machine and four spins per cycle to cover what you owe.

Whatever is left over is yours to spend. It is also the only way you will ever be strong enough to survive the next deadline.

That is the whole game.

Build a machine, not a hand


Every symbol you own sits in the reels. Every charm you equip bends the maths.

  • 22 symbols — fruit, metal, wilds, and cursed ones that pay enormous and cost you later
  • 40 charms — conditional multipliers, compound interest, RNG manipulation, and build enablers that make an entire archetype viable
  • Buy, remove, upgrade — a crowded deck rarely lines up. Knowing what to cut is half the game

Multipliers apply once per combination. Concentrate your deck, chain the right charms, and a single spin can pay a debt you could not have imagined ten minutes earlier.

Seven machines, eight stakes


  • The Classic — three reels, three rows, where you learn
  • The Wide — four reels, lower values, longer lines
  • The Held — hold a symbol between spins
  • The Tall — three reels, five rows, verticals that run deep
  • The Broken — one cell of the grid is dead, and it moves every cycle
  • The Blind — the last reel stays covered. Pay to see it, or spin without knowing
  • The Double — two grids, one budget of spins

Each machine carries eight escalating stakes. Higher quotas, pricier shops, fewer spins, fewer charm slots — and at the top, a creditor who curses your deck and breaks the symbol you built everything around.

Numbers that go very large


Multipliers stack per combination. The ceiling is not a design decision, it is arithmetic — and reaching it is a build you construct on purpose, not a jackpot you wait for.

No real money. Ever.


Lucky Debt is a game about debt, not a gambling simulator. There are no purchases, no real currency, and nothing to win but the next cycle.

Maybe you have already kept cats, fish, tiny bugs, or all kinds of curious little companions on your desktop.
This time, the one staying by your side is a dog.

 

 Lucky Dog Rise is a warm and relaxing desktop pet game. You can bring a little dog to your desktop, where it stays in a corner of your screen and keeps you company while you work, take a break, or play games, letting a little luck slip into your everyday routine. Meeting you is the luckiest thing that ever happened to this pup. That is why it is called Lucky Dog.
 

It will not get in your way or nag you to do anything. It simply stays there, watching you finish one small task after another, cheering you on in its own little ways. When you play other fullscreen games, it can step aside for a while and leave your screen space to the battle ahead.

  

While you focus on your work, every keystroke and every mouse click gradually builds up Lucky Points. Your everyday actions are no longer just typing and clicking. They become part of your dog's growth and rewards.

 

When you want to relax, switch to card mode and play a light poker-style mini game with your dog. Choose which cards to keep, draw new ones, and earn more Lucky Points through a little judgment, a little luck, and the quiet bond between you and your pup.

 

Use Lucky Points to get new blind boxes, collect outfits, items, and fresh looks. Make the desktop dog who has always stayed by your side cuter, more special, and more truly your own companion.

 

"Busy days come apart at the edges. A little dog stitches them back together."

  

Leave a spot for this little dog on your busy desktop.
 

 


All in all, if you enjoy desktop companion games like Bongo Cat — or have ever wished for something like Bongo Cat, but with a dog — Lucky Dog Rise might be just what you’re looking for. It’s a cute dog desktop pet game where a little puppy can stay by your side, hang out near your taskbar, and keep you company while you type, click, work, or play. Inspired by the charm of Shiba Inu dogs, Doge-style internet culture, and even the playful idea of a Menswear Dog, Lucky Dog Rise lets you collect different hats and outfits, dress up your dog, and turn your desktop companion into a look that feels truly your own. Whether you’re looking for a puppy on your desktop, a Shiba Inu desktop pet, a Doge-like dog companion, a dog on your taskbar, a dog with hats, or simply a cozy desktop dog game to leave running in the background, Lucky Dog Rise is made to be your little everyday companion.
