Roll, hold what's worth keeping, roll the rest again. Make a hand, confirm it, and that spends one of your hands for the stage. Clear the target score before you run out and you move down a stage. The hands are the ones you already know from Yahtzee. What changes is the dice themselves and the way the score is counted.

Hold and Reroll

Dice you hold stay as they are through a reroll, and only the rest are rolled again. Both the hands you get per stage and the rerolls you get per hand are limited. Whether to confirm now or roll once more comes down to the rerolls you have left and how far the target still is.

The Shop Between Stages

Clear a stage and a shop opens, where the chips you earned go toward the next one. Charms keep working for as long as you hold them. Some multiply what you score, others change the rules of the table. Engravings rework a die's faces so it rolls something else. A die coated in a material gets a score multiplier when it goes into a hand. The same one pair can be worth different amounts depending on which dice made it. What the shop stocks differs every time, so which hands are worth going for differs from run to run.

Dealer's Tricks

On the way down there are stages where the dealer has bent one rule. A red preview marks them before you get there. Some stop certain faces from counting at all, others change the way the score is counted. Depending on which trick is in play, the setup that worked until then does not work the same way on that stage.

The VIP Room

A VIP run puts the whole run on the line from the first stage. The Essence you collect pays double, but go down and you lose all of it. You can also stop partway and walk out with what you have.

After a Run

Miss the target score and the run ends there, and the dice and charms you gathered on it are gone. Essence (★) is not. The permanent upgrades you buy with it at the Essence shop apply to every run after that.

Fully offline singleplayer.

Diverse Synergies

Purchasing equipment is the primary way to play. Each item slot is part of a set, and equipping all pieces of a set grants a powerful bonus.

Item Upgrades

Collect equipment of the same type to upgrade your items!

Various Skills

You can select character skills based on the changing situation in each game. Skills provide general utility, increases in various stats, or bonus effects tailored to specific builds

Unique Bosses

At the end of each stage, a boss will stand in your way, making it difficult for the player to advance. These bosses possess special abilities and will test the player's proficiency. Therefore, with every journey, the player must make choices that create synergy to become strong enough to be unstoppable!

Lucky Sip blends classic time-management business simulation with roguelike deckbuilding. Choose buff cards every time you level up — no two shop runs play the same.

Two game modes await you: Stage Mode offers relaxing, classic level progression. Challenge Mode keeps you on edge with ever-rising rent for tense, fast-paced gameplay.

Delicious Drinks

Four drink categories: tea, juice, milkshakes and smoothies. Over a dozen signature beverages paired with baked treats and snacks to satisfy all kinds of customers.

Diverse Customers

Meet more than a dozen customer types including elementary students, high school students, university students, office workers, housewives, wealthy patrons, beggars and thieves. Each has unique behaviors and preferences, and can trigger powerful synergies. Earn their favor to unlock powerful souvenirs.

Rent Challenge

In Challenge Mode, the landlady comes to collect rent regularly, and rent only keeps going up! Strategically combine drinks, customers and buff cards to beat the landlady and build your very own blockbuster bubble tea shop.

Customizable Starts

Pick from multiple starting characters. Each has their specialty drinks and exclusive card pools. Mix with souvenirs to experiment with countless build strategies.

Satisfying Controls

Play with mouse and keyboard, fully rebindable keys. Classic mechanics like rapid serving are here, delivering that signature satisfying gameplay of time-management sims.

MAKE EVERY SCREEN A PART OF THE EXPERIENCE

Games. Movies. Music. LumaEdge turns the displays you already own into reactive ambient lighting.

Extend color across extra monitors. Fill the black bars on an ultrawide or TV or transform your PC’s audio into a customizable full-screen visualizer.

No LED strips. No lighting hub. Just the screens you already own.

A DIFFERENT APPROACH

Instead of stretching a game or video across every display, LumaEdge keeps it exactly where you choose and samples its edges in real time.

Dense forests seem to extend beyond your screen, neon city lights wash across your entire setup, and bright explosions fill your desk with light. The colour flows naturally into the space around your content, creating a bigger, more immersive experience with virtually no performance impact and none of the usual setup time that comes with traditional multi-monitor gaming or ultrawide fixes. 

TURN UP THE SCREEN

Music, games, microphones, or anything playing through your PC can drive a fully customizable visualizer across an entire display or even on the sides of your ultrawide.
Choose a style, shape the reaction, and let your audio take over the room.

HARDWARE YOU ALREADY OWN

No LED strips. No capture cards. No hubs, controllers, adapters, or anything else to buy.

LumaEdge is software. It runs quietly in the background and turns the screens you already own into reactive ambience. 
An ultrawide?  A television? A multi-monitor setup? HDR? All at the same time? Luma works around your setup, then gets out of the way.  Choose where you want the effect, and where you don't. Then let Luma take it from there. 

WORKS WITH PRETTY MUCH EVERYTHING

LumaEdge doesn't need plugins, game integration, title-specific support, or a new setup every time you switch apps.

Games. Movies. Streams. Browsers. Desktop apps. Whatever you're watching or playing, Luma is ready!

READS YOUR SCREEN, NOT YOUR GAME

LumaEdge uses the same screen capture method as taking a screenshot. It never reads or touches game memory, never stores whats on your screen, and never injects into game processes. It simply reacts to what's already on your display.

MAKE IT YOURS

A subtle glow? Your whole setup bathed in colour? Something completely unhinged? LumaEdge gives you deep control over how it looks, moves and reacts.  
Customize each display individually, save profiles for games, movies, music and moods, then switch between them in seconds.

Lumenal lets you see the world through a photographer's eyes. After a stressful day, pick up your camera, chase your assignments through all kinds of places and enjoy the quiet calm that comes with landing the perfect shot. Cities, forests, glaciers, savannas and so much more...

Grab a coffee and set off on this adventure alone, or bring your friends along and double the fun. One of you tries to catch the animal while the other gets the shot. Or set up your tripod and everyone strike a pose!

The forest waiting to be explored is just the beginning. Bundle up in your warmest clothes for the glacier, home to penguins and polar bears. Or put on your hat, hop in your jeep and try to catch the right moment on the savanna. Think there's nothing left to see in the world? Then new planets and new species are right up your alley!

On the way to your target, a bike race with your friends can be fun. Or motorbikes. Or hey, why not ATVs. But I'd say none of it is quite as fun as pushing a friend out of a helicopter...

Sharpen your photography skills with assignments that keep getting tougher. As your reputation grows, new assignments, new sites and new targets open up. Get the whole city talking about you! But watch out, the competition is your own friends: who'll take the best shot in Photo Hunt?

  • Play solo or in online co-op (1–4 players)

  • Forest, glacier, desert, savanna, city, underwater and planets to discover

  • Light that changes with the hour, different weather every day

  • Scored photos, polaroids and a photo board

  • Bicycle, motorbike, ATV, safari jeep and helicopter

  • Sites, reputation and the Photo Hunt party mode

  • Dress up your character however you like, with outfits for every world

  • Steam Achievements

  • 9 languages

Don't forget to add Lumenal: A Photo Break to your wishlist.

Raise your daughter to greatness in a world of adventure, mystery, and choices that shape her destiny.

In Luminara: The Second Dawn, you are a traveling merchant—and a single father. From childhood to adulthood, your daughter's future is entirely in your hands.

Every month, you decide what path she'll take:

  • Study hard and become a Royal Scholar?

  • Travel far and become a Champion of the Kingdom?

  • Or live a quiet, ordinary life?

  • Or maybe… walk a path no one ever expected?

Her story is yours to shape.

Gameplay Features

🌸 Raise her your way!

Should she focus on her studies, or head out on adventures? Make friends, or fall in love? Maybe even… get into a little "trouble" along the way? Every choice leads to a completely different story.

👭 A whole world of friends awaits!

Dozens of unique characters are waiting to meet you—friends, close companions, and maybe even that special someone. Build strong bonds, unlock exclusive storylines, and discover endings that change with every choice you make.

⚔️ Go on adventures, face mighty foes!

Explore four completely different adventure maps, packed with treasure, secrets, and powerful bosses waiting to challenge you. Every boss has their own tricks—so you'll need to think fast to come out on top!

🧳 Travel far and wide as a merchant!

Leave the city behind. Trade goods, haggle with customers, fight off bandits, and discover new cities like Virensgate—with even more places on the way!

🎉 70+ endings—you'll never get bored!

Careers, marriage, friendship… each playthrough unlocks new rewards that carry over to your next journey. The more you play, the richer the story becomes!

Ready to take on the most important role of all?

✦ EVERYTHING STARTS WITH A SEED ✦

What you grow today will shape what your Luminon becomes tomorrow.

Grow magical crops and go fishing to feed your Luminons and directly improve their stats. Raise a Tank to hold the front line, power up a Ranger to strike from the back, or... boost a Luminon's appeal and turn it into the star of the beauty contests.

You decide how they grow.

✦ BUILD A LUMINON LINEAGE ✦

One Luminon can be special. An entire generation can inherit something extraordinary.

Pair your Luminons and breed new generations that inherit their parents' genetics. Generation after generation, you can improve their genetic potential and, while an egg is incubating, use magical powders to boost your Luminon's stats before it even hatches.

✦ THE FOREST IS NEVER THE SAME ✦

Every day in the Luminous Forest is different.

Explore 5 rotating biomes where wild Luminons and rewards change every day. Find creatures roaming the forest, offer them food, and complete the taming minigame to bring them back to your ranch.

✦ 1 LUMINON. 5 POSSIBILITIES ✦

Lumen. Umbra. Flora. Ether. Crystal.

The same Luminon species can come in different types, colors, genetics and stats, meaning no two members of the same species have to be exactly alike.

Each species also features its own hand-crafted animations.

But raising the perfect Luminon only matters if you can watch it shine...

✦ FIGHT YOUR WAY ✦

They fight. You build the strategy.

Build a team of 3 Luminons and decide the role each one will play in the arena: Ranger, Fighter or Tank. Their position changes their strengths, and your formation is completely up to you.

Then use your Tamer abilities during battle to heal, deal damage, buff your team or weaken your opponents at just the right moment.

✦ OR MAKE YOUR LUMINON THE STAR OF THE SHOW ✦

Not every champion needs to win a battle.

Raise Luminons with high Appeal, Charisma and Presence and take them to the stage. In beauty contests, every judge has their own preferences, and each decision can win over one judge while losing points with another.

Plan your strategy and steal the spotlight.

✦ FIND YOUR PLACE IN THE LUMINOUS FOREST ✦

Farm, fish, prepare food for your Luminons and enjoy life on the ranch at your own pace.

They say Luminons never choose the wrong person.

Somewhere in the Luminous Forest, one may already be waiting to find you.

Grow Giant and Challenge Legendary Monsters!

A Survivor-Style Roguelite RPG

Grow Giant and Crush Your Enemies

The core feature of Lunadra is its Giant Form and Tiny Form system, which can be activated periodically.
In Giant Form, unleash overwhelming power and massive area attacks to wipe out hordes of enemies.
However, transforming requires enough space, making positioning and timing critical.
In Tiny Form, gain incredible speed and enjoy a high-mobility dodge-focused combat style.

Deadly Battles Against Legendary Monsters

Standing before the player are terrifying Legendary Monsters capable of threatening the world itself.
Massive area attacks, devastating magic, and relentless assaults await.
Surviving these extreme battles will not be easy.

Create Your Ultimate Build

Freely combine Weapon Cards, Support Cards, and Beast Cards to create your own combat style.
Different combinations dramatically change your strategy and abilities, allowing for deep build customization.

Intense Battles Packed Into 10 Minutes

Hordes of enemies, gigantic bosses, and flashy skills collide in explosive combat.
Experience the thrill of survivor-like gameplay packed into intense 10-minute battles!

2-Player Co-op Supported

Challenge legendary monsters together with a friend or family member.
Work together and survive overwhelming encounters!

Story

In the world of Valdia, legendary monsters reign supreme.
Ancient beasts have destroyed countless kingdoms.
Luna, a black cat adventurer, receives forbidden power from the ancient dragon Selva.
It is an ancient magic known as Scale Change, capable of freely altering the user's size.
Now, the small adventurer begins a battle to surpass the legends.

Controls

While a controller is recommended, this game also supports keyboard and mouse controls.

Keyboard

  • Move: W / A / S / D

  • Aim Weapons: Arrow Keys (↑ ↓ ← →)

  • Giant Form: E

  • Mini Form: Q

  • Confirm: Enter / Space

  • Back: Shift

  • Pause: Esc

Mouse

  • Move: Left-Click and Drag

  • Aim Weapons: Right-Click and Drag

  • Menu Navigation: Left-Click

When a controller is connected, an in-game control guide will be displayed.

Lead your creatures to glory under the moon.

Lunar Wardens is a creature team manager for up to 8 players. Everyone runs their own team in the same live world at the same time. You hire creatures, train them, build up your Hall and fight your way up the league table. When match day comes, everyone stops and watches the fights together in the arena.

Build your team

Hire creatures from the Wanderers' Inn, where every team shops from the same pool, or take a chance on a mystery egg. Send scouts into the wilds to explore the map, and hunt wild packs for experience and new catches. Level your creatures up and evolve them into stronger forms. Each creature has its own element, a basic attack, a special attack and traits that change how it fights. Fire, Water, Grass, Electric, Ice, Ground, Dark and Dragon each beat some elements and lose to others.

Set the line-up, then watch

Before each bout you place your creatures on the arena floor. Brawlers hold the front, while casters and shooters stay at the back. Then the fight runs by itself. Creatures charge, burrow, leap, freeze, burn and shield their friends. A good line-up and the right element matchup win fights. A knockout can be deadly, so choose when to risk your best creatures.

Run your Hall

Spend Gold, Wood, Stone and Iron to build and upgrade your Hall: a Beast Barn to keep more creatures, a Healing Hut to bring the fallen back sooner, a Scout Spire for more scouts, a Moon Shrine to reroll traits, and a Sawmill, Quarry and Iron Mine that produce materials every day. Buy and sell at the Harbour, where every team trades from the same stock, so the richest team can buy it out first.

One season, sixteen teams

Sixteen teams play a full home-and-away league. Every month ends with a cup knockout of all sixteen. Players who don't show up are replaced by AI teams that play to win. Friends can join a season already under way and take over an AI team.

Features

  • Up to 8 players in one shared, live season

  • A league of 16 teams, human or AI, plus a monthly cup

  • Auto-battle fights you set up and watch live in the arena

  • Dozens of creatures across eight elements plus Neutral, each with its own skills and traits

  • Hire, hatch mystery eggs, scout, hunt, build and trade between matches

  • Level up and evolve your creatures

  • Join a running season at any time

A TRUE CRIME SIMULATOR — VOLUME I

You are Detective Partridge, investigating the disappearance of a missing girl at a run-down trailer park at the end of a gravel road. Piece together the mystery of what happened to Abby Pullman by cross-examining the residents of the trailer park and searching for clues.

TALK LIKE A DETECTIVE

Type your own questions. Investigate how you want. There are NO dialogue trees. What they will tell you, what they will deny, and what they emotionally cannot face yet are all subject to change. Push them with evidence you find, or inconsistencies in their stories. Watch composure crack or earn trust.

They do not recite scripts. They hold secrets. And they will not say what they do not know. Investigate the crime by asking the characters ANYTHING you want, just like a real detective. 

INVESTIGATE LIKE IT MATTERS

The environment of the trailer park holds secrets to discover just as much as the characters do. Learn as much as you can to confront the characters with evidence and expose the truth of what happened to Abby Pullman. 

THE SUSPECTS:

Chuck Pullman: a father who will not leave his campfire until his daughter comes home. 

Daisy Brichard: the sweetest grandmother imaginable, baking for when Abby gets back. 

Desmond Lloyd: a paranoid man nobody believes. He may be right about everything.

⚠ PLEASE READ BEFORE PLAYING / REVIEWING ⚠

Detective games feel like what LLMs were made for, and Lurks Beneath is my attempt at the real thing: question suspects in your own words, about anything, the way an actual detective would.

The suspects run on an AI that lives entirely on your machine. Nothing is sent to the cloud, and no account or internet connection is needed. That's also why your hardware matters so much. On the recommended specs, suspects answer in a few seconds. On weaker machines, they slow down. Below the minimum specs, expect 20+ seconds per answer, and an interrogation with that much dead air just isn't fun.

Short version: the better your computer, the better the interrogations. Play the free demo first. If it runs well for you, the full game will too.

Note: generative AI is used in one place: the suspects' replies to your questions. The game loads a local, offline LLM (Llama 3.1 8B), and code around it keeps each answer in character and in line with the story. Generative AI was not used to create the game. It's only a gameplay mechanic.

Made by Morph

Lynayly is a real-time deck builder whose focus is built around four player co-op.

The full game will feature:

  • Online four player co-op

  • Action rogue-like deckbuilding

  • Multiple heroes with distinct abilities

  • Map events, rewards, and upgrades

  • Dark fantasy enemies and environments

  • World map and lore

FAQ

What exactly is a cooperative, real-time deck builder?

Players will team up together to make a deck of cards. When battling monsters there is no turns. Cards and mana are given on a timer as opposed to every turn. This eliminates the down-time of waiting for your turn that turn-based deck builders have.

Will the game be playable with less than four players?

Yes. The game supports 1–4 players. Any heroes not controlled by a player will be controlled by AI companions.

Lynxwood: The Secrets Beneath is a first-person survival horror game set in a dying town in the Oregon wilderness. Follow the trail of your grandfather's disappearance from his apartment building into the heart of Lynxwood: its fog-choked forests, its abandoned streets, and the tunnels that run beneath everything.

Something has lived under this town for a long time. And the people who worship it never left.

  • Explore a dying town: an apartment building with a rotten heart, a lonely gas station on the forest road, the old factory that once fed the town, and the woods that swallowed the people who asked too many questions. Every location hides keys, notes and secrets that pull you deeper underground.

You are Sam. Not a soldier, not a detective. Just the last person who still cares what happened to John Carter. Your grandfather spent his final years digging into Lynxwood's past, and when his letters stopped coming, you came looking. All he left behind is a locked room, a stack of research, and a warning you ignored. Now his trail leads below the town, and the only way out is through.

Lynxwood's secret didn't keep itself. For generations, a congregation has guarded what sleeps beneath the town and fed it. Follow your grandfather's research into their rituals, learn why the archaeologists who came before you never left, and discover what the faithful have been breeding in the flooded depths.

Classic survival horror, played in first person. Ammunition is scarce, your flashlight eats batteries, and every bullet you spend is one you won't have later. Fight when you must, run and hide when you can. Restore power, repair machines, find keys and solve environmental puzzles to open the path forward. Piece the story together through notes, newspapers, tapes and an old computer that hold the truth about the missing archaeologists, your grandfather, and what lies beneath Lynxwood.

  • Atmospheric first-person survival horror built on realistic lighting and sound

  • A focused, handcrafted story campaign

  • Scarce resources: manage your ammo, batteries and healing items

  • Fight or evade the creatures breeding in the flooded depths

  • Environmental puzzles: restore power, repair machines, open paths deeper underground

  • A rich paper trail of notes, tapes and newspapers that reward exploration

  • Full keyboard/mouse and controller support (Xbox & PlayStation)
